title: Seedence 2.5 launches UGC video creation with premium #seedence2_5 #ugcvideo #skincareindustry
description: Claude created a 30-second UGC video featuring a woman in her bedroom using Seedence 2.5. The video highlights a daily skincare routine incorporating the Burberry branded T-shirt, emphasizing sensitive skin care and product engagement. Seedence 2.5 demonstrates advanced AI content generation with high consistency, allowing users to craft personalized videos by connecting their Orkut account and providing detailed character references. This technology streamlines creative workflows for marketers and content creators seeking authentic user-generated content.
